Order 
19.10.2023 Heard Mr. K Rahman, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as Mr. B Sarma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.

This application under Section 438 Cr.P.C, is preferred by the petitioner, Page No.# 2/3 namely,
Noren Baruah, praying for pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.284/2023 arising out of Borpathar P.S. Case No. 38/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/468/379/34 IPC.

The FIR unfolds that the owner of the truck bearing registration No.AS-03- BC-8888 Rajesh Agarwala in conspiracy with the owner of the godown Noren Baruah, the present applicant had been smuggling subsidized fertilizer to the neigbouring states.

The truck, in question, was intercepted when Rokib Ali and Ranjan Bhuyan were transporting fertilizer, concealed in the garb of Noren Boruah vs The State Of Assam on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128213863/
1 transporting tamarind powder.

sentences.text: After the interception and checking of the vehicle, an FIR was lodged against the accused named therein.
It is submitted that the petitioner was not aware that fertilizer was being smuggled from his godown as the petitioner has let his godown on rent.

I have heard the learned Additional Public Prosecutor who has raised serious objection by stating that there are incriminating materials against the petitioner in the case diary, who is the owner of the godown and the documents which were seized by the police were forged documents.
I have considered the submissions made at the bar with circumspection and have also perused the case diary.
Indeed, there are cogent incriminating materials against the petitioner in the case diary.
At this juncture, there appears to be no justified ground to extend the privilege of pre-arrest bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly the pre-arrest bail stands rejected at this stage of investigation.
Send back the case diary.
